snippet.title: Freshly Caught - Run a Cozy Fish Stall - Gameplay Teaser (Steam)
snippet.description:
Catch fish, arrange your stall, and run a cozy neighborhood fish stand by the water. 🎣 Set up your stall, serve customers by finding the right fish for them, upgrade your gear, and grow your tiny seaside business one catch new and rare fish!

Wishlist now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4703240/Freshly_Caught/
